name: craft-memory
description: Standalone scoped and evidence-linked memory for AI hosts.

interface.shortDescription: Scoped memory and reproducible context receipts.
interface.longDescription: Resolve working, episodic, preference, and procedural memories by scope, provenance, expiry, sensitivity, and evidence without requiring Craft's full orchestration loop.
defaultPrompt: Resolve only the memories relevant to this task and explain why each was selected.
